overclaims: Evidence so far fits the forecast: in October 2025, the best agent automated only 2.5% of real freelance projects.
No credible data show agents doing a large share of knowledge work broadly, so nothing has settled it early.
There is no standard economy-wide measure of the share of work done by agents.
checks.note: The abstract reports 2.5% on a benchmark of real-world projects; it does not identify them as freelance projects or measure deployed automation. The search found no economy-wide measurement; that does not establish that no credible data or standard measure exists. Qualify absence claims to the evidence packet.
